svg.text: Protocol stack — one transport, two encodings, four contracts
Everything below the encoding row is shared by every flow. Only R1 leaves JSON behind.
UTF-8 text · versioned · one JSON Schema per contract
UDP — one PDU per datagram · ports 47100 / 47200 / 47300 · no broker, no middleware
IPv4 · static addresses 10.99.0.10–.13 · same subnet, so no routing and no gateway
R6 — CarSky Ethernet Bridge Node · one L2 segment 10.99.0.0/24
R1 is the only non-JSON encoding in Milestone 1, and the only place a third-party codec appears — every other contract is plain JSON against a committed schema.
R3 never travels alone: it is the schema every ego-side track obeys, reaching the wire only as the object snapshot embedded in an R4 message.
Two languages decode R4 — C++ writes it, Kotlin reads it — which is why the schema, not either implementation, is the authority.
